defmodule MonitorAgent.Schema do
  use Absinthe.Schema

  alias MonitorAgent.{Repo, Log, User}

  import_types MonitorAgent.Schema.Types

  query do
    @desc "Fetch logs with filtering"
    field :logs, list_of(:log_entry) do
      arg :filter, :log_filter
      arg :limit, :integer, default_value: 50
      resolve &MonitorAgent.Resolvers.Logs.list_logs/3
    end

    field :system_metrics, :metrics do
      resolve &MonitorAgent.Resolvers.Metrics.get_metrics/3
    end
  end

  mutation do
    field :create_log, :log_entry do
      arg :message, non_null(:string)
      arg :level, non_null(:log_level)
      arg :metadata, :string
      resolve &MonitorAgent.Resolvers.Logs.create_log/3
    end
  end
end

defmodule MonitorAgent.Resolvers.Logs do
  alias MonitorAgent.{Repo, Log, QueryBuilder}

  def list_logs(_parent, args, %{context: %{current_user: user}}) do
    case authorize_log_access(user, args) do
      :ok ->
        query = QueryBuilder.build_log_query(args, user)
        {:ok, Repo.all(query)}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  def list_logs(_parent, _args, _resolution) do
    {:error, "Authentication required"}
  end

  def create_log(_parent, args, %{context: %{current_user: user}}) do
    case user.role do
      role when role in ["admin", "agent", "writer"] ->
        attrs = Map.put(args, :user_id, user.id)
        Log.changeset(%Log{}, attrs) |> Repo.insert()
      _ ->
        {:error, "Insufficient permissions"}
    end
  end

  defp authorize_log_access(user, args) do
    cond do
      user.role == "admin" -> :ok
      user.role in ["agent", "reader"] -> :ok
      true -> {:error, "Insufficient permissions"}
    end
  end
end

defmodule MonitorAgent.QueryBuilder do
  import Ecto.Query
  alias MonitorAgent.Log

  @allowed_filter_fields ~w(level source timestamp_start timestamp_end)a

  def build_log_query(args, user) do
    base = base_query(user)
    apply_filters(base, args[:filter], user)
  end

  defp base_query(%{role: "admin"}), do: from(l in Log)
  defp base_query(%{role: role, id: user_id}) when role in ["agent", "reader"] do
    from l in Log, where: l.visibility == "public" or l.user_id == ^user_id
  end
  defp base_query(%{id: user_id}) do
    from l in Log, where: l.user_id == ^user_id
  end

  defp apply_filters(query, nil, _user), do: query
  defp apply_filters(query, filter, user) do
    Enum.reduce(filter, query, fn {key, value}, acc ->
      apply_single_filter(acc, key, value, user)
    end)
  end

  defp apply_single_filter(query, :level, value, _user) do
    from l in query, where: l.level == ^value
  end

  defp apply_single_filter(query, :source, value, _user) do
    from l in query, where: l.source == ^value
  end

  defp apply_single_filter(query, :timestamp_start, value, _user) do
    from l in query, where: l.inserted_at >= ^value
  end

  defp apply_single_filter(query, :timestamp_end, value, _user) do
    from l in query, where: l.inserted_at <= ^value
  end

  # Dynamic field search - allows searching across configurable fields
  defp apply_single_filter(query, :search, %{field: field, value: value}, user) do
    apply_dynamic_search(query, field, value, user)
  end

  defp apply_single_filter(query, _key, _value, _user), do: query

  defp apply_dynamic_search(query, field, value, user) do
    # Role-based field access control
    accessible_fields = get_accessible_fields(user.role)
    field_atom = normalize_field(field)

    if field_atom in accessible_fields do
      build_search_fragment(query, field_atom, value)
    else
      query
    end
  end

  defp get_accessible_fields("admin"), do: ~w(message source level metadata user_id)a
  defp get_accessible_fields("agent"), do: ~w(message source level metadata)a
  defp get_accessible_fields(_), do: ~w(message source level)a

  defp normalize_field(field) when is_binary(field) do
    field
    |> String.downcase()
    |> String.trim()
    |> String.to_existing_atom()
  rescue
    ArgumentError -> :invalid
  end

  # Uses the validated atom field for safe dynamic column reference
  defp build_search_fragment(query, field_atom, value) do
    safe_value = "%#{String.replace(value, "%", "\\%")}%"
    from l in query, where: ilike(field(l, ^field_atom), ^safe_value)
  end
end

defmodule MonitorAgent.Plug.Auth do
  import Plug.Conn
  alias MonitorAgent.{Repo, User, Token}

  def init(opts), do: opts

  def call(conn, _opts) do
    with ["Bearer " <> token] <- get_req_header(conn, "authorization"),
         {:ok, claims} <- Token.verify(token),
         %User{} = user <- Repo.get(User, claims["sub"]) do
      put_private(conn, :absinthe, %{context: %{current_user: user}})
    else
      _ -> conn
    end
  end
end
